jtube_subset_policy: first 35, 70, 140 training labels in original selection-freeze order
checkpoint_policy: fixed final update; no validation checkpoint or phoneme selection
normalization_policy: same existing train-only feature statistics in all conditions
evaluation_policy: five vowels required in query and claimed enrollment; equal phone means using shared enrolled inventory; retain failed queries as rejection
calibration_policy: separate per model and corpus; validation FAR1pct only; freeze all model hashes and thresholds before test
interpretation: one-seed exploratory scaling comparison, not proof of pure speaker-count causality or robustness
baseline_policy: reuse completed all36 model with identical settings and input bytes; train three new conditions from the same initial encoder
